review.publication: Local only. No commit, push or deployment.
review.scope: Physical area, volume, density, power and force; derived units; measurement purposes and laboratory liquid instruments.
review.attribution: Reviewed adaptations of Open English WordNet 2025 by the Open English WordNet Team, derived from Princeton WordNet. CC BY 4.0 and the underlying Princeton notice are retained in docs/quality/2026-10-09-q11.md#sources-and-reuse. BIPM quantity/unit information is adapted with attribution there. Manufacturer sources support instrument functions; names, scope restrictions and graph mappings are reviewed adaptations.
review.context_policy: Every new concept and relation uses U1 and unspecified strength. Existing home contexts and all grammar rows are preserved; U2 remains empty.

sense_decisions.scope: The two-dimensional extent quantity, distinct from a public square or geographical region. It has length-squared dimension.
The three-dimensional extent quantity, distinct from a book volume, sound loudness, or concept extension.
Mass per volume. This is narrower than generic amount-per-unit-size and distinct from optical density, population density, crowdedness and relative density.
Mass density of a liquid sample, with measurement conditions such as temperature specified in actual use.
The ratio of sample mass density to a stated reference mass density under specified conditions. It is dimensionless, unlike mass per volume. Do not automatically fix every reference to water.
Rate of energy transfer or work, distinct from energy itself and from political power. Classify it as a physical quantity rather than copying the physical-phenomenon genus.
The physical force quantity, distinct from coercion, military force, muscular strength and power. Do not copy the broad physical-phenomenon dictionary genus.
The rate of electrical energy transfer. Do not apply voltage-times-current without specifying instantaneous/DC/AC conditions; apparent and reactive power are not imported as synonyms.
Energy transferred or supplied electrically, distinct from its rate of transfer. Exclude the dictionary power and electricity synonyms from this selected quantity.
A unit for mass per volume, not a unit of the dimensionless relative-density ratio.
A length-per-time unit applicable to speed and velocity values. The scalar speed quantity and a vector velocity remain different meanings.
A length-per-time-squared unit. It is not a subtype of a speed unit.

Political power remains distinct from the rate-of-energy-transfer quantity.

review.limits: The graph records instrument purposes and process targets, not formulas or executable unit conversions. Relative density is not mass density; no kg/m3 unit is assigned to it. A device may need other equipment to perform its intended measurement. Calibration conditions, precision, universal materials, fluid-handling procedures and electrical safety instructions are not inferred. Weight 44, general energy/heat descendants, width/geometry, and the power-measuring dynamometer sense remain pending. No application test suites.

collision_decisions.area_quantity: Preserve the separate public-square concept 2142; bare Russian area/square spelling is a homonym.
collision_decisions.physical_power: Preserve political power 2667; the new quantity has a qualified canonical label.
collision_decisions.physical_force: Preserve the coercion verb 3759; force as a quantity has its own qualified identity.

refreshed_comparison.caveat: Exact normalized English spellings are candidates, not semantic identities or a missing-concept count.
